The narrow street and pavement recede toward the right distance past lower residential houses, metal fences, leafy trees with a few yellow leaves and practical street lamps. Worn asphalt with repaired seams, subdued grey building facades, intact lived-in windows. Beyond a low fence on the right, a small neighborhood ball court and a bench suggest everyday community life. Lighting: pale September sunshine on upper walls and foliage, cool blue-grey shadows below, a few fading rain puddles.
